items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Got through playing the number with Royston.

ctx.x: Can you excuse us for a minute? Yeah.

I said, after every set, opportunity set, the way you're playing, I said, you pull them strings out of tune. See? Oh, yeah? I said, yeah. I said, no, I'm going to show you. Got through playing the number with Royston. Boom, Royston. I said, hit your A. He said, you got a tune. I said, well, no, all right. I said, I had my tune right before that. That stopped that, you know?
I am. I'm going to tell you. I'm going to tell you.
